course.description.source: A free course with 17 lessons about AI and the digital world through social studies: where AI came from, who builds it and at what cost, how it changes daily life, and who decides how it is used.
course.description.back: A free course with 17 lessons about AI and the digital world through social studies: where AI came from, who builds it and at what cost, how it changes daily life, and who decides how it is used.

sections.0.title.source: How AI developed and how it works
sections.0.title.back: How AI developed and how it works
sections.0.title.note: Replaces "Mesin yang berfikir" (Thinking machines), the earlier English title.

sections.0.question.source: Where did AI come from, and how does it work?
sections.0.question.back: Where did AI come from, and how does it work?

sections.0.description.source: Trace how AI developed from the 1950s to today: the ideas people tried, the setbacks and successes, and what made each change possible. Then see how two of today's approaches work: a model that learns from labelled examples, and a large language model.
sections.0.description.back: Trace how AI developed from the 1950s until today: the ideas people tried, setbacks and successes, and what made each change happen. Then see how two present-day approaches work: a model that learns from labelled examples, and a large language model.
sections.0.description.note: "Setbacks" is "kemunduran"; "kegagalan" (failures) was avoided as harsher than the English.

sections.1.title.source: Who builds AI, and at what cost
sections.1.title.back: Who builds AI, and what does it cost

sections.1.question.source: Who makes AI work, and who pays for it?
sections.1.question.back: Who makes AI work, and who bears its cost?

sections.1.description.source: Meet the people behind AI, weigh the power and water it uses, ask which languages it speaks, and see why it works better for some people than others.
sections.1.description.back: Get to know the people behind AI, weigh the electrical energy and water it uses, ask what languages it speaks, and see why it works better for some people compared with other people.
sections.1.description.note: "Power" here means electricity, so "tenaga elektrik", not "kuasa" (which Lesson 7 uses for power over decisions).

sections.2.question.source: How is AI changing work, school and community life?
sections.2.question.back: How is AI changing work, school and community life?

sections.2.description.source: Look at how AI changes jobs, health, farming and school, and weigh safety against privacy when cameras can recognise faces.
sections.2.description.back: See how AI changes work, health, farming and school, and weigh safety against privacy when cameras can recognise faces.

sections.3.question.source: Who decides what we see, and how AI is used?
sections.3.question.back: Who decides what we see, and how AI is used?

sections.3.description.source: Check fake pictures and claims, see how feeds choose what we see, compare the rules people are making for AI, and plan an AI helper for a community.
sections.3.description.back: Check fake pictures and claims, see how feeds choose what we see, compare the rules people make for AI, and plan an AI helper for a community.
sections.3.description.note: "Feeds" is "suapan" (DBP's word, as in "suapan berita"); check that learners know it.
